registered_before_data: Written before any historical bid/ask quote for the bundle universe was pulled or inspected. Known beforehand: the model's half-spread is clip(Corwin-Schultz 60-session mean / 2, 3 bp, 2%); on panel_large its median is about 24 bp; published large-cap quoted spreads are believed to be a few bp, which motivated this check.
question: Does the Corwin-Schultz half-spread used in research.name_costs match quoted half-spreads for the same names and dates?

data.source: LSEG Workspace / CodeBook, lseg.data get_history, daily interval, fields BID and ASK (end-of-day consolidated quote), all RICs in data/raw/historical/8433bd236228ba351c9a/security_master.parquet, 2015-09-01 to 2026-10-30.
data.cleaning: Keep days with BID > 0, ASK > BID and (ASK-BID)/mid < 0.20. Quoted half-spread q = (ASK-BID)/(2*mid). Per name, trailing 60-session mean of q ending on the decision date, at least 40 valid days, mirroring the cs_spread window.
data.join: panel_large rows (date, symbol) via security_master ticker/security_id -> ric.

comparison.model_value: hs_model = clip(cs_spread/2, 0.0003, 0.02), exactly as name_costs uses it.
comparison.quoted_value: hs_quoted = trailing 60-session mean q as above.
reported: coverage share of panel rows with hs_quoted
median and mean of hs_model and hs_quoted
share of rows with hs_model > hs_quoted
the same by year and by panel market-cap tercile
Spearman rank correlation across names per date (median over dates)
mean one-way cost under the current model and under the v2 rule below, at the same $600 order

decision_rule.cost_model_v2: Half-spread = max(hs_quoted, HALF_SPREAD 3 bp floor), falling back to the current clip(cs_spread/2, 3 bp, 2%) where hs_quoted is missing. FX fee and impact terms unchanged.
decision_rule.adoption: Adopt v2 if hs_quoted covers >= 80% of panel_large rows, whatever the direction of the difference (a measured quote is preferred over a range-based estimate a priori). If coverage < 80%, keep the current model and report the comparison only.
decision_rule.no_tuning: No other spread estimator, window, floor or cap is tried. The 3 bp floor and $600 order are unchanged.

known_limitations: End-of-day quoted spread, not effective or intraday time-weighted spread; effective spreads with price improvement are usually at or below quoted, so v2 is if anything conservative for marketable orders of this size.
Closing-auction quote snapshots can be wider or narrower than the intraday average.
Delisted RICs may lack quote history; coverage is reported.
evaluation: Cost-model measurement, not a signal trial. Any rerun of strategy results under v2 is a new trial on a reused holdout, exploratory only, logged in the trial ledger; no gate threshold changes.
